# aether_invoices (Data Source)

The organization's invoices, newest period first. Amounts are integer cents. The buyer and issuer details printed on an invoice are not exposed. Pages beyond the first hundred invoices may skip or repeat entries until the platform's cursor pagination is fixed (aether-api #318).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `invoices` (Attributes List) The invoices, in the API's order (newest period first). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invoices))

<a id="nestedatt--invoices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `invoices`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Invoice UUID.
- `invoice_number` (String) Customer-facing invoice number (`AE-YYYY-NNNN`).
- `period_end` (String) End of the invoiced period (RFC 3339).
- `period_start` (String) First day of the invoiced period (RFC 3339).
- `status` (String) `draft`, `issued`, `paid` or `void`.
- `subtotal_cents` (Number) Net amount in euro cents.
- `tax_cents` (Number) Tax in euro cents.
- `tax_note` (String) Tax note printed on the invoice (e.g. reverse charge).
- `tax_rate_bp` (Number) Tax rate in basis points (1900 = 19%).
- `total_cents` (Number) Gross amount in euro cents.
